title: Bare bones Reinmagined
description:
This add-on for Bare Bones texture pack, refreshes Minecraft default 26.2+ textures.
To look like trailer.
body:
# What is this?
> This is add-on for Bare Bones resource pack, i made it cause bare bones got discontinued.

# What it adds?
> Bare bones: **Rein**magined, adds new textures to Minecraft inspired by Minecraft trailers.
> *Specificly: sulfur blocks set, cinnabar blocks set, and it will keep going when next Minecraft update will be released.

## Why you should download it?
> Cause if you like Bare Bones, but want to play on newer versions of the game, this resourcepack is perfect for you!

### Important notice!
> Not all texture's are made, like for sulfur cube, so if you have 1:1 order from the gallery image **Order**, Minecraft will use default vanilla texture's.

> Btw, if you want bare bones for version 26.1 - 26.1.2, install original bare bones, there's like nothing to change in 26.1. Oh and also ignore fact that Minecraft says, that original bare bones is for older version of the game.
